text: Something was coming to her. <break time="0.8s" /> And she was waiting for it fearfully. <break time="0.8s" /> Though she did not yet know. <break time="0.8s" /> What it was. <break time="0.8s" /> It was too subtle and elusive to name. <break time="0.8s" /> But she felt it creeping. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of the sky toward her. <break time="0.8s" /> It reached her. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the sounds, the scents, and the color. <break time="0.8s" /> That filled the air. <break time="0.8s" /> On that spring day. <break time="0.8s" /> Now her chest rose and fell rapidly. <break time="0.8s" /> For she was beginning to recognize the thing. <break time="0.8s" /> That was approaching to take hold of her. <break time="0.8s" /> She was trying to beat it back. <break time="0.8s" /> With her will but her will was as powerless to stop it. <break time="0.8s" /> As her two white, slender hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Her will giving way at last. <break time="0.8s" /> She let herself go. <break time="0.8s" /> And a little whispered word. <break time="0.8s" /> Escaped from her slightly parted lips. <break time="0.8s" /> She said it over and over under her breath. <break time="0.8s" /> Free, free, free. <break time="0.8s" /> And the vacant stare. <break time="0.8s" /> And the look of terror. <break time="0.8s" /> Left her eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> Her eyes became keen and bright. <break time="0.8s" /> Her pulse beat fast. <break time="0.8s" /> And the flowing blood warmed and relaxed. <break time="0.8s" /> Every inch of her body.
